name: Lagosanto (Italy)
description: Vertical tricolour of blue, white and blue, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Lagosanto (a yellow shell on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Lagosanto, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Lagosanto arms — yellow shell on blue, crowned, within branches
